result.title: Abstention Spends Its Budget on Local Label Variance More Than on Novelty: Auditing Conformal Calibration and Selective Prediction under Molecular Scaffold Shift
result.summary: Selective prediction with split conformal calibration promises a post-hoc fix for molecular property prediction: abstain on the least reliable compounds, ideally out-of-distribution chemistry, and the retained set becomes trustworthy without retraining. We audit this recipe for a gradient-boosted fingerprint model on lipophilicity (regression) and BBBP (classification) under a Bemis-Murcko scaffold split, holding the fitted model and evaluation molecules fixed while varying only the calibration fold (18 replicates). (i) On lipophilicity, coverage depends on calibration provenance: calibrating on held-out training-scaffold molecules falls below nominal (PICP 0.841 at a 0.90 target), while novel-scaffold calibration recovers it (0.904); on BBBP, coverage stays above nominal in every regime. (ii) For split conformalized quantile regression (CQR) the conformal correction is a constant, so conformalization does not change what is abstained on. (iii) The abstention score (CQR width; effectively ensemble variance on BBBP) tracks local label variance more than chemical novelty: controlling for local label variance largely explains away the novelty association (partial Spearman 0.067 and 0.047). (iv) At a fixed assay budget, gating on interval width or ensemble variance never improves hit precision over ranking by point prediction, at the pre-specified operating point or across 20 exploratory settings; a plain novelty gate shows small, uncorrected gains at the smallest budgets. (v) In an exploratory analysis, exact conformal selection exceeds its false discovery rate target under training-scaffold calibration (0.303 at q=0.2) and is consistent with it under novel-scaffold calibration, contributing a data-driven batch size rather than a better ranking. Conformalization earns its keep through guarantees whose validity hinges on calibration provenance, not by choosing what to abstain on.

AI.brief_summary: 在 Bemis-Murcko 骨架划分下审计分子性质预测的 split conformal 校准与选择性预测：固定模型仅更换校准折重复 18 次，检验覆盖率是否依赖校准来源、弃答分数究竟追踪标签局部方差还是化学新颖性，以及按区间宽度或集成方差门控能否提升命中精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「弃答信号实际反映的是局部标签方差而非新颖性」的审计设计，可能为 LVR 中 STOP 决策与 latent 相似度是否被内容以外因素（噪声、位置、深度）混淆提供对照框架，跨域迁移尚需核查。
